0.label: head_face_calm
0.description: A small, calm face with lowered lids and a fringe of strokes over the brow, at the top centre of the rim between two ribbed blocks.
0.iconography: The ojú ọpọ́n (Ẹ̀ṣù) at the head of the tray; here serene rather than fierce.

1.label: fowl_on_right_rim
1.description: A bird with a fan-grooved wing and down-turned head, set in a compartment on the right rim between ribbed bars; a matching bird sits on the left rim.
1.iconography: The sacrificial fowl again (compare EBA-Div_00302 #2, FoA_04-5580 #2): the offering that follows divination, here paired on both sides.

panel.title: Rectangular Modakeke Ifá tray: calm face, paired fowls, a crab and corner mudfish
panel.summary: A spare rectangular tray whose rim alternates ribbed blocks with plain swellings. A calm face marks the head; a fowl sits on each side; a crab marks the foot; long mudfish-like creatures bend around the four corners.

register_readings.reading: The head: a calm face between ribbed blocks.
The sides: a fowl on each, facing each other across the field.
The foot (undetected): a crab at the centre; mudfish curving round the corners.

panel.composition: Strictly symmetrical: face and crab on the vertical axis, fowls on the horizontal, mudfish at the corners. Ribbed blocks give the rim a regular beat.
panel.narrative: A quiet, orderly tray: Ẹ̀ṣù at the head, the crab and mudfish of the water, and two fowls ready for sacrifice. Four cardinal points, four corners — a small cosmogram around the working field.
panel.hypotheses: Neutral for 'chronicle'. The ribbed blocks are regular (eight around the rim) and could be tested against the tray's quartered layout, but no count is evident.
uncertainties: The bottom creature could be a tortoise; the corner creatures could be crocodiles.
